key_insight: An augmented block preconditioner enables robust iterative solution of fully coupled, two-phase incompressible inductionless MHD systems.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports simulations of conducting two-phase flows with discontinuous material properties while preserving discrete charge conservation.
method: Discretize current density, velocity, electric potential and pressure using high-order monolithic ALE finite elements and backward Euler time stepping.
Add grad-div stabilization to the current-density and momentum equations.
Solve the coupled system with FGMRES using an augmented Lagrangian block preconditioner and approximate block factorizations.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests confirm high-order accuracy and discrete charge conservation; a heavy-fluid drop benchmark demonstrates robustness to material-property discontinuities and mesh size.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify iteration counts, runtime gains or scalability for the large, ill-conditioned four-field systems.
paper_title: Robust augmented Block Preconditioning for two-phase Incompressible Inductionless MHD
